title: Landnam mission
description: One mission definition. Compiled into shared/missions/authored-missions.json, which the web and native catalogs both read.

format.description: Authoring format version. Not copied into the compiled JSON.

id.description: Stable mission id used by saves, the board and both platforms. Never rename a shipped mission.

title.description: Name shown on the mission board.

brief.description: The client's request in plain language, shown to the player.

tag.description: Board badge such as TRANSPORT or FREE OPS.

client.description: Client id. Leave out for player-owned work, which pays no fee.

locked.description: Locked missions stay on the board but cannot be accepted yet.

sequence.description: Where the mission sits in progression. Use a name so it follows the game's own constants: transport is the onboarding transport lesson, free-ops is the first Free Ops tier.

unlock_at.description: Plain-language unlock condition shown while the mission is locked or gated.

target.description: Target id where the ore is mined.

delivery_target.description: Target id for the second leg of a two-leg job, before the flight home.

minerals.description: Mineral id to the amount that must be delivered.

cargo_min.description: Smallest cargo hold, in units, that can fly this mission.

drill_tier.description: Drill tier needed to reach the ore.

max_orbit.description: Furthest orbit band the vehicle must reach.

payout.description: Give exactly one of francs or floor_sequence.

francs.description: A fixed fee in francs. Use 0 for player-owned work.

floor_sequence.description: Pay the standard contract fee for this sequence. Follows the fee curve when it is retuned.

tickets.description: Linear tickets this mission belongs to.

note.description: Plain-language note for whoever edits this mission next.

preview.description: Where the Scene Studio opens this in the real game, with no login.

route.description: Game screen to open, such as missions.

state.description: Stage fixture (dev preset) that puts the game in the right state.
